notes: Auth: the firebase CLI login (a project owner), so security rules do not apply.
Only values, document ids, HTTP statuses and error statuses and messages are recorded; they are exact.
Each case is one commit of one document in aruma-ref-values-bad (ids c000, c001, … in case order). Long strings in requests are compacted (length and SHA-256).
A depth of n counts the containers (maps and arrays) around the innermost value of field d; the document's own fields are depth 0.
